# All Token Types

## Percentages

Our model achieved 87.3% accuracy on the test set.

## AUROC Values

The receiver operating characteristic curve showed AUROC=0.92
with AUC 0.915 for the primary outcome.

## N Counts

We analyzed N=500 samples in the main cohort and N=50 in the pilot.
The sample size was n = 250 for cross-validation.

## Decimal Ratios

The correlation coefficient was 0.734, with a precision of 0.891
and recall of 0.756 on the validation set.
